content:
本模组为Macaw的桥梁/栅栏/屋顶/家具/楼梯系列与Abnormals团队模组提供多模组兼容支持。
安装后会自动为其他模组的材料添加对应的桥梁/屋顶/栅栏等建筑部件。

常见问题：
Q：已安装Macaw's Bridges - Abnormals兼容包，担心安装本模组会导致现有桥梁消失？
A：无需担心，本模组会自动转换旧版兼容包的所有方块和物品。

注意：本模组是Macaw系列的非官方扩展，如遇崩溃或bug请提交至[问题追踪页](https://github.com/Samlegamer/Macaw-s-Addons/issues)。

支持模组清单：

- Macaw桥梁
![桥梁图标](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jZrq3qzM/images/c31eabc8a3940f7e3ad1b4294b709d7aeea1911d.png)
- Macaw屋顶
![屋顶图标](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jZrq3qzM/images/cca8f153d896d8a1d37691f503f8c55c9f196780.png)
- Macaw栅栏
![栅栏图标](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jZrq3qzM/images/9ebf067ac442acfd2e764a8c0515ddac10082b71.png)
- Macaw家具
![家具图标](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jZrq3qzM/images/bdf41da17f2a7f0c2ac5caeee70c04e551d9ac76.png)
- Macaw楼梯
![楼梯图标](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jZrq3qzM/images/166e26bac2227526c4c2d1a32ac8777dd22ca00a.png)

1.1版本更新内容
![更新图示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/jZrq3qzM/images/5aaba117ceede98dac715cb13808d1d5b0f1c625.png)

必装前置：

- [AddonsLib基础库](https://modrinth.com/mod/addonslib)
- [Blueprint框架](https://modrinth.com/mod/blueprint)

推荐搭配：

- [Macaw系列模组](https://modrinth.com/user/sketchmacaw)

_Abnormals系列兼容支持：_

- [蜂群嗡嗡](https://modrinth.com/mod/buzzier-bees)
- [生态环境](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmental)
- [水域升级](https://modrinth.com/mod/upgrade-aquatic)
- [秋日物语](https://modrinth.com/mod/autumnity)
- [末地拓展](https://modrinth.com/mod/endergetic)
- [大气生态](https://modrinth.com/mod/atmospheric)
- [洞穴裂隙](https://modrinth.com/mod/caverns-and-chasms)
